_comment: Who uses the Go code that phase 2 of ADR-036 deletes (docs/adr/036-single-parser-effective-config.md
section 9 and its implementation map; #2766, #2486). Phase 2 may delete a package or a vendored
yaml.v3 patch only once its users below are gone or rewritten.
from the source of BOTH Go modules (components/threshold-exporter/app, components/tenant-api)
with go/parser and goes red when they differ from this file in either direction.
Package level, not per symbol (owner decision on #2766, 2026-10-10): what stays inside a package
importers: one row per (repo-relative directory, whether the importing file is a _test.go file);
every .go file counts whatever its build tags, external `_test` packages included; not read:
the module root's third_party/ (a third_party/ deeper down is read) and testdata/ at any depth.
spaces_only_callers: every `.SpacesOnly` selector (call or method value) outside the module root's third_party/.
patches: exactly the third_party/*.patch files on disk, the same set
Dispositions: package delete | split; patch keep | delete-with-routingpolicy | delete-when-unrelied.

packages.category: ADR-036 section 9: Go code imitating how Python (PyYAML) reads YAML
packages.notes: The whole package decodes a yaml.v3 node into the value PyYAML's SafeLoader builds. Once the generator is the only parser nothing needs it; delete it after every importer below is rewritten.

packages.category: ADR-036 section 9: Go code imitating how Python reads YAML, mixed with small helpers unrelated to parsing
packages.notes: Deleted: the PyYAML emulation, e.g. shapeWork, pyResolve, ParseDomainPolicies, UnmarshalPolicy and the policyDecoder that turns SpacesOnly on. Kept or moved to another package (ADR-036 section 9, last row): helpers that do not parse, e.g. IsValidTenantID (ADR-035), LevelOf, IsDomainPolicyFile. Which side each remaining symbol falls on is decided when phase 2 is written, not tracked here.

patches.reason: Always on (decode.go keeps Tag "!" on a non-plain scalar), so no call site shows who depends on it. Delete only once no code relies on the Tag == "!" behaviour. The packages below are believed reliant; that is NOT mechanically proven, and removing their imports does not prove the behaviour unused.
Adds the Decoder.SpacesOnly option, off by default; only routingpolicy's policy reader turns it on (spaces_only_callers). Deleted together with that code.
Linear duplicate-key detection for large mappings; the exporter's own config decoding uses it for performance, independent of the PyYAML emulation.
